brakes.front_caliper_designation.description: Front caliper seal-kit designation in Honda catalog

candidates.notes: Front caliper seal kit 01463-TXM-A01 fits 5 Door 1.5T Sport Touring 6MT/CVT. Honda caliper codes of this form are commonly read as piston diameter in mm (57) and minimum wheel size (15 in) - that reading is a lead, not confirmed.

candidates.how_to_measure: Measure the front caliper piston OD with calipers (±0.1 mm) during a pad change.
candidates.notes: Lead: 57 mm from the 'AD57-15"' seal-kit designation (unconfirmed reading).
searches: hondanews.com 2022 press kit (says single-piston, no bore)
hondapartsnow caliper listing (front seal kit 'Ad57-15"' designation only)

candidates.how_to_measure: Measure the rear caliper piston OD with calipers (±0.1 mm) during a pad change.
searches: hondanews.com 2022 press kit (says single-piston, no bore)
hondapartsnow caliper listing (front seal kit 'Ad57-15"' designation only)

candidates.how_to_measure: Look at the firewall behind the master cylinder: vacuum booster with hose from intake/pump vs electric booster; photograph.
searches: 2022 press kit chassis section (no booster type)

candidates.value: electric parking brake (EPB) with automatic brake hold; rear caliper-mounted actuator
candidates.evidence: Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) with automatic brake hold
candidates.as_printed: Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) with automatic brake hold
candidates.notes: Rear caliper actuator: hondapartsnow lists 43018-T20-A02 'CALIPER SUB-ASSY; Actuator, Caliper' fitting 5 Door 1.5T Sport Touring. Manual cars: press kit says parking brake button is left of the shifter.

candidates.how_to_measure: Not directly measurable at home; use OE pad edge code (e.g. FF) from a pad photo.
candidates.notes: Bias derivation assumes equal mu front/rear.
searches: no published OE pad mu found
